scenarios.label: Scenario G — Multi-Tier Global Enterprise (Escalation)
scenarios.description: Multi-tier global structure that requires human compliance review. Root: Delaware LLC. Parent: Cayman holding company. Above that, a Singapore Pte Ltd held in part through a nominee, a BVI holding company, and an irrevocable Swiss trust with foreign-national beneficiaries. Three jurisdictions, nominee arrangement, offshore intermediary, and an irrevocable trust + foreign nationals — the agent should call recommend_escalation.
